creative_intent: A continuous cinematic visual argument with one persistent material carrier and authored camera energy.
visual_language: Frosted acrylic editorial with sculpted luminous surfaces, deep atmospheric layers, and restrained kinetic type.
continuity_carrier: A luminous route ribbon that physically transforms into the structural material of each subsequent beat.

styleframes.hero: Primary attention owner and opening visual thesis
styleframes.composition: Asymmetric close detail with designed copyspace and foreground occlusion
styleframes.quality_note: Hero silhouette, material response, depth separation, and thumbnail authority inspected

styleframes.composition: Medium push-in with strong foreground/background separation
styleframes.quality_note: Still frame remains production-ready without relying on motion

styleframes.composition: Camera passes through the transforming hero instead of loading a new screen
styleframes.quality_note: Transition preserves readable hierarchy at peak speed

styleframes.composition: Readable landing with intentionally different framing from the opening
styleframes.quality_note: No primitive shortcuts, generic cards, or empty dead stage

styleframes.hero: Persistent carrier resolved into final statement
styleframes.composition: Large-scale lock with visual memory of the entire journey
styleframes.quality_note: Final frame has equal or greater authority than the build-up

proof_of_motion.scope: The most difficult camera push-through and continuity transformation
proof_of_motion.playback_note: Reviewed at normal speed and reduced speed; acceleration, impact, readability, and settle remain clear

scenes.depth_plan: Foreground occluder, sculpted hero midground, atmospheric background
scenes.type_role: Hero phrase participates in framing and transition causality

transition_to_next.cause: The hero phrase compresses into the persistent carrier
transition_to_next.action: Carrier gains depth and camera accelerates through its surface
transition_to_next.result: The same surface becomes the environment of beat 02
transition_to_next.continuity: Material identity, camera velocity, and light direction remain continuous

scenes.purpose: Resolve the first transformation into a readable semantic state
scenes.hero: Same carrier in a new structural role
scenes.depth_plan: Hero occupies dominant midground with shallow foreground parallax and restrained atmosphere
scenes.type_role: Short annotation locks to the transformed hero rather than floating independently

review.summary: Representative stills and the proof-of-motion section were reviewed before final rendering; the piece reads as one evolving visual world rather than a sequence of screens.
rejected_shortcuts: Generic primitive stand-ins for hero objects
